description: This file defines a React component for a complex interactive webpage, including a visual mind map, a career roadmap with milestones and stages, and associated utilities for handling role plans, state persistence, SVG-based visualizations, and animations.

classes.name: RoadmapTab
classes.description: Type alias representing different tabs for the roadmap view.

classes.name: SkillDelta
classes.description: Type defining a skill's current and target levels.

classes.name: MilestoneStatus
classes.description: Union type for milestone completion states.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: Type representing a project milestone with metadata.

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: Type representing a role-focused development plan including skills and milestones.

classes.name: SkillStatus
classes.description: Type alias for skill assessment status in the mind map.

classes.name: MindMapSubNode
classes.description: Type representing a subnode within a category in the mind map.

classes.name: MindMapCategory
classes.description: Type representing a category node in the mind map, containing subnodes.

classes.name: MindMapNodeKind
classes.description: Union type for different kinds of mind map nodes.

classes.name: MindMapNode
classes.description: Type representing a node in the mind map, with positioning and tooltip info.

classes.name: MindMapEdge
classes.description: Type representing a connection (edge) between mind map nodes.

methods.name: polarPoint
methods.description: Compute Cartesian coordinates from polar coordinates for placing nodes in circular arrangements.

methods.name: mixToWhite
methods.description: Interpolate between a given RGB color and white based on a parameter t.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Create mind map categories and subnodes based on role attributes.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Generate the model of nodes and edges for the mind map visualization, including position calculations.

methods.name: RoadmapAmbientBackground
methods.description: React component rendering animated background particles for visual effect.
